propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking way to verify that mapped project keys and legacy_default are visible to the bot without running a full reconcile pass.

Bridge fsck must add an opt-in --live-visibility flag that calls a shared visibility helper to check mapped-project visibility, reusing the logic from the reconcile pass preflight rather than hand-rolling a duplicate existence check.

The live-visibility advisory must gracefully degrade when Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete, skipping the probe call and emitting a skipped verdict without failure.
The new diagnostic output must be written to stderr in both text and JSON modes to leave the stdout schema unchanged and preserve the default exit contract.
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free and no reconciler/agents imports from optional extras must leak into _commands/doctor.py.
